label: The standard instructions
subgoals: Select the bypass register with BYPASS
Select the boundary register with SAMPLE/PRELOAD or EXTEST
Select the 32-bit identification register with IDCODE

label: Path lengths
subgoals: Include every instruction register in an IR scan
Add the selected data register lengths along the chain for a DR scan
Count one bit for each bypassed device

label: Conventions that tools rely on
subgoals: Capture the fixed 01 pattern in each IR to check the chain
Read device IDs with a DR scan right after reset
Preload safe boundary values before switching to EXTEST
